newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Insurance doesn't see H2 repeating H1.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Insurance doesn't see H2 repeating H1.

text.p: Hambro Insurance Services Group Plc, reporting a 49 percent rise in half-year pretax profits, said on Thursday it did not expect to maintain its current rate of increase in trading levels in the second half.

"The six months' results have benefited from last year's hurricanes and accordingly we do not expect trading in the second half to show the same extent of seasonal bias as previous years," chairman Christopher Sporborg said.
"Having said that, the underlying performance of our loss-adjusting business is much better than for some years," he added in a statement.
Hambro, part of merchant bank Hambros Plc, posted pretax profits of 4.53 million stg in the first half ended Sept. 30 compared to 3.03 million stg in the year-ago period.
